edit_summary: Commit e6884a39 closes round 2's two findings under ruling D(2)'s own words (「例外を撤回し直接書く」): the publication-journal-recovery Block writes Resolver Evidence, and writes it directly. Six sites, located by grepping every sibling statement of both facts before writing any of them. (1) REQ-001 step (m): the one-member Block write set is published directly (temp file + fsync + rename), no staging area and no journal, because the journal exists to roll a multi-target rename sequence back as a unit and on the (0) Block a second journal against the Feature whose journal was just declared unconvergeable would be incoherent. (2) REQ-004: the mechanism is scoped by write-set size - alongside the rest of a track's output set Evidence is not exempt from the journaled transaction; as the only artifact written it is direct - and the same edit records that REQ-004's sole exception and REQ-002's two named exceptions are two different scopes. (3) requirements.md Security Boundaries: that sentence governs staged artifacts and a sole-Evidence Block stages nothing. (4) design.md's recovery enumeration and (6) infra-spec.md's Unrecoverable branch: the live-state obligation stated per target - every interrupted target other than resolver-evidence.yaml exactly as found, and resolver-evidence.yaml itself receiving this invocation's own Block record. No AC or TEST id added, renumbered or removed; the diagnostic-id enum stays closed at sixteen; no exception is added to REQ-002.
